newsitem.title: USA: AMEX to list Insignia, Lawyers Title options.
newsitem.headline: AMEX to list Insignia, Lawyers Title options.

text.p: The American Stock Exchange (AMEX) said it will list options on shares of Insignia Financial Group Inc and Lawyers Title Corp on March 7.
Insignia options will have initial strike prices of 17-1/2, 20 and 22-1/2, with expirations in March, April, June and September. Group One Trading will be the specialist unit.
Lawyers Title options will have strikes of 20, 22-1/2 and 25, with expirations in March, April, June and September. LETCO-Specialists LP will be the specialist unit.
Position limits are 4,500 contracts for both issues.
